title: KaizenNote
description: Frontmatter of kaizen/KAIZEN-YYYY-NNN.md: why a task needed rework. The agent writes it with status proposed; the dashboard then opens a Kaizen context update from it (server/src/services/kaizenIntake.ts) and marks it moved. /gtd-task (Step 10) refers to this file. Notes applied or rejected before Kaizen moved to context updates keep their status as history.

status.description: Write proposed. moved is set by the dashboard once it opened the context update; applied and rejected are from before.

area.description: Optional grouping, e.g. instructions, templates, commands.

task_ref.description: The task whose rework triggered the note.

symptom.description: What went wrong in the task, as the executive saw it.

root_cause.description: What instruction or signal was missing (the cause, not the symptom).

proposed_fix.description: The change that would prevent recurrence. A suggestion: the analysis of the context update drafts the real change.

files_affected.description: Workspace-relative paths you think should change.

rejected_at.description: When the dashboard rejected the proposal; retention starts here.

context_update.description: Set by the dashboard: the context update it opened from this note.

moved_at.description: Set by the dashboard with context_update.
